purpose: Meta Graph blind set: active repositories affected by a retired or retiring Graph API version, a removed or changed field or edge, or a shut-down product, none in an earlier list or the dev set. Nobody opens, traces or debugs these repositories; they run only in the combined Meta benchmark at the end.
criteria: GitHub code search (10 queries; one with more than 1,000 results also run once per file-size range: <2000, 2000..4000, 4000..8000, 8000..16000, >16000 bytes) for graph.facebook.com/v URLs, facebook-nodejs-business-sdk, FB.init with a version, graph.instagram.com and WhatsApp Cloud API messages, excluding every repository named in any JSON file under docs/benchmarks/ (4257 repositories). Kept: not archived, not a fork, under 50 MB; a default-branch commit within 90 days of 2026-10-29 with at least 2 distinct human commit authors in that window (bots excluded), loosened only while the blind set was short, first to 180 days and then to 1 author (loosening lists the steps applied; each repository's activity names the strictest rule it meets); a .github/workflows directory; a root package.json and exactly one root lockfile (package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lock). Up to 2000 of the most starred were cloned at their default-branch HEAD, scanned offline with `refit meta-graph --json` and `refit meta-graph --propose-version-moves --target v26.0 --json` and a text search for FB.init versions and Instagram Basic Display scopes (user_profile, user_media) in live files, then deleted. Affected: a live request or FB.init on a Graph API version retired by 2026-10-29 (data/deadlines.json, or older than its oldest entry) or retiring within 365 days, a live request a reviewed change in data/meta-graph-changes.json removes or changes on the way to v26.0, or Instagram Basic Display scopes (product shut down 2024-12-04). Affected repositories are ordered by SHA-256 of "meta-sets:<owner/name>" (lower-cased); the first 100 are the blind set and the next 60 the dev set, which is not frozen when fewer remain.
